title: OpenPulse labelled applicability case set
description: One file per dataset version (DATASET_CARD.md). A case is one dependency reference evaluated against one or more upstream events, with a label assigned under LABELING_GUIDE.md.

version.description: Dataset version; a changed label or case is a new version.

status.description: Freeze state and labelling provenance, in words.

events.description: Stable event identifier -> how to obtain the event as known at its knowledge cut.

fixture.description: Fixture directory: event.json plus SOURCES.md with the provenance of every field.

class.description: Event category (compromised, deprecation, distribution, eol, licence, relocation, ...).

as_of.description: Knowledge cut: the event as it was known on this date.

encoding.description: Frozen OSV/OpenVEX encoding for baseline R, with its SHA-256.

id.description: Stable case identifier, unique in the file.

ref.description: Container reference as written by the dependent.

label_source.description: Where the evidence for the label is: SOURCES.md and the dependent's file at a commit.
